notes: This trace is limited to the standard MIM object-instance-information query/report response shapes. It checks the owned-attribute list and registered/known class fields for owned and known instances, then verifies the NULL form after the requester removes local knowledge. It does not claim complete joined-federate MOM or object-management conformance.

requirements.statement: The test uses the standard sendInteraction service and parameter map to request information about an object instance known to the requesting federate.

The request identifies one object instance and results in one HLAreportObjectInstanceInformation. For an object known by the joined federate, the report carries its owned instance-attribute list, registered class, and known class. If the joined federate does not know the instance, the report is a NULL response with an empty owned-attribute list and omitted registered/known classes. The test checks all three states and decodes the standard nested attribute-handle list using public RTIambassador handle decoding.
